dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 25, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Tampa Bay Rays Crush Kansas City Royals 13-2**

The Tampa Bay Rays exploded for 13 runs, led by Junior Caminero's historic 3-home run, 6-RBI performance. Caminero's 5-hit night paced the Rays' offense, while Ian Seymour dominated on the mound, pitching 6.2 innings of shutout ball with 7 strikeouts. Carter Jensen added to the Rays' power with his 11th home run of the season.
